messages.author: b483bc009759278f
messages.subject: Error in strsplit(x = uFilename[p], split = "[.]csv") : non-character argument in part6AlignIndividuals.R
parts:
When I run the mode 6, I got this error: Error in strsplit(x = uFilename[p], split = "[.]csv") : non-character argument

I rerun the part6AlignIndividuals.R using my data, discovered that the uFilename was the name of RData rather than the csv.

In part6AlignIndividuals.R, line 52: the original code was: pat1 = unlist(strsplit(x = uFilename[p], split = "[.]csv"))[1]

I wonder if there was a bug in line 52 and how to solve this.

Thank you so much!
